verdict_text:
YES

The script maps each adapter pair to `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.query_key_value.weight`, computes `B @ A` in float32 (the adapter dtype), scales by `lora_alpha / r = 2`, adds to the float32-upcast base weight, and casts back to float16, honoring `fan_in_fan_out = false` (no transpose). Adapter tensors are never inserted into the state dict, all other tensors pass through untouched, and the four required checks are asserted before any file is written. Sharding packs tensors in order under the 536,870,912-byte tensor-data limit, starts a fresh shard when a tensor would overflow it (so an oversized tensor lands alone), and writes `model.safetensors.index.json` with a complete `weight_map`.
